fact: INSEED released the revised Annuaire statistique national 2024 in August 2026 (original December 2025), covering 2020 to 2024 and drawing mainly on administrative reports and sectoral information systems of ministries, with chapters on education, health, justice, social security and more; 63 of 67 targeted structures returned data.

Togo's Ministry of Territorial Administration began training sessions on 28 August 2025, running to 5 September, for communal civil-registry officials as part of a reform to improve the collection and use of civil-registration statistics, with UNFPA and INSEED as partners.

Togo's territorial administration ministry asked the mayors of the 117 communes to send the numbers of births, transcribed supplementary judgments, marriages and deaths registered from 2019 to 2024, by 21 February 2025, to build national statistics on civil-status events.
